from datetime import datetime, timezone

import boto3


def query_metric_window(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=config.get("region"))
    response = client.get_metric_statistics(Namespace=config["namespace"], MetricName=payload["metric"],
        Dimensions=[{"Name": k, "Value": v} for k, v in config.get("dimensions", {}).items()],
        StartTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["start_time"], timezone.utc),
        EndTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["end_time"], timezone.utc),
        Period=config.get("period_seconds", 60), Statistics=["Average"])
    points = [{"timestamp": p["Timestamp"].timestamp(), "value": float(p["Average"])} for p in response["Datapoints"]]
    return {"points": sorted(points, key=lambda p: p["timestamp"])}

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import boto3

def aggregate_metric_stats(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=config.get("region"))
    response = client.get_metric_statistics(Namespace=config["namespace"], MetricName=payload["metric"],
        Dimensions=[{"Name": k, "Value": v} for k, v in config.get("dimensions", {}).items()],
        StartTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["start_time"], timezone.utc),
        EndTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["end_time"], timezone.utc),
        Period=config.get("period_seconds", 60), Statistics=["Sum", "Minimum", "Maximum", "SampleCount"])
    stats = {"sum": response["Datapoints"][0].get("Sum", None),
              "min": response["Datapoints"][0].get("Minimum", None),
              "max": response["Datapoints"][0].get("Maximum", None),
              "count": response["Datapoints"][0].get("SampleCount", None)}
    return stats

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import boto3

def filter_metric_dimensions(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=config.get("region"))
    response = client.get_metric_statistics(Namespace=config["namespace"], MetricName=payload["metric"],
        Dimensions=[{"Name": k, "Value": v} for k, v in config.get("dimensions", {}).items()],
        StartTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["start_time"], timezone.utc),
        EndTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["end_time"], timezone.utc),
        Period=config.get("period_seconds", 60), Statistics=["Average"])
    points = [{"timestamp": p["Timestamp"].timestamp(), "value": float(p["Average"])} for p in response["Datapoints"]]
    return {"points": sorted(points, key=lambda p: p["timestamp"])}

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import boto3

def compare_metric_series(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=config.get("region"))
    response1 = client.get_metric_statistics(Namespace=config["namespace"], MetricName=payload["metric1"],
        Dimensions=[{"Name": k, "Value": v} for k, v in config.get("dimensions1", {}).items()],
        StartTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["start_time"], timezone.utc),
        EndTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["end_time"], timezone.utc),
        Period=config.get("period_seconds", 60), Statistics=["Average"])
    response2 = client.get_metric_statistics(Namespace=config["namespace"], MetricName=payload["metric2"],
        Dimensions=[{"Name": k, "Value": v} for k, v in config.get("dimensions2", {}).items()],
        StartTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["start_time"], timezone.utc),
        EndTime=datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["end_time"], timezone.utc),
        Period=config.get("period_seconds", 60), Statistics=["Average"])
    points1 = [{"timestamp": p["Timestamp"].timestamp(), "value": float(p["Average"])} for p in response1["Datapoints"]]
    points2 = [{"timestamp": p["Timestamp"].timestamp(), "value": float(p["Average"])} for p in response2["Datapoints"]]
    return {"points1": sorted(points1, key=lambda p: p["timestamp"]),
            "points2": sorted(points2, key=lambda p: p["timestamp"])}

import boto3

def dashboard_note_translate(note, source_lang, target_lang):
    translate_client = boto3.client('translate')
    response = translate_client.translate_text(Text=note, SourceLanguageCode=source_lang, TargetLanguageCode=target_lang)
    return response['TranslatedText']

import boto3

def metrics_export_archive(metric_data, bucket_name):
    s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
    file_name = f"metrics_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}.json"
    s3_client.put_object(Body=metric_data, Bucket=bucket_name, Key=file_name)
